data.name: girl to girl, _
data.what_it_is: Woman to woman, _: a candid, sisterly opener for confessing a personal problem, usually a disappointing skincare result, in a frank, exasperated register. The blank holds a first-person complaint or story, e.g. "I wore an acne patch all night just to wake up with a huge whitehead."

data.name: day _ of _
data.what_it_is: Day _ of _ means "It's day _ of my ongoing attempt at _." Creators use it for serial, diary-style logs of a numbered daily attempt at a personal goal; tone is usually casual. The blanks take a day count and the activity, as in "Day 6 of learning everything I know about meme coins."

data.name: your sign to _
data.what_it_is: This is your sign to _: a casual nudge giving permission or encouragement to do something. Creators use it to nudge viewers toward an action or share one they're taking, in a casual second-person register. The blank is the action or experience, e.g. 'your sign to go on a pumpkin patch date.'

data.name: get ready with _ to _
data.what_it_is: Get ready with _ for _: dress and prep alongside whoever fills the blank, ahead of the stated occasion. Creators usually open casual, friendly get-ready or outfit-transformation videos, inviting viewers along. The blank names the companion(s) and the occasion or destination, e.g. "Get ready with us for our first day here in Dubai."

data.name: rare aesthetic: _
data.what_it_is: "An unusual, niche personal trait or vibe: _" — creators open by labelling a quirk, habit or situation as a "rare aesthetic", usually in a playful, casual register. The blank names that quirk or situation, e.g. "thinking these were 'mini trashcans' in the restrooms".
